notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Two major gameplay changes were added with this update:

1. From this moment all prestige upgrades prices will be increased with every 20th purchase (every 10th before)
2. Added prestige points refund system.
Now you can refund all spent prestige points. It works like a common prestige restart, but this time all prestige upgrades will be reset too. 

Fixed UI bug with wrong text positioning that may occur from time to time.
